scope: Supplementary local active-inference profile and one warmed dashboard navigation observation; not a controlled browser performance benchmark

conditions.api: isolated loopback API on port 8002 with a temporary data root

browser.observation: Clicked Analytics and captured the accessibility state; the Traffic observation analytics heading and camera-health table were present.
limitations: A single accessibility-action plus state-capture duration is not click-to-paint, INP, or a percentile.
Browser main-thread work, video playback drops, network throttling, and low-end hardware were not measured.
The six replay sources and temporary API do not represent live capture or real-time camera feeds.
This is a 20-second local replay sample; it does not establish sustained throughput or target-device behavior.
The first CAM-01 attempt includes lazy model initialization; later aggregate throughput reflects the warmed process.
Three configured source files were missing and did no decode or inference work.
Vehicle and plate accuracy, OCR behavior, and six-stream browser playback were not tested.
The profiler counter window starts after the first sampled health state; the first CAM-01 initialization attempt took 4.90 seconds and had one budget overrun before the measured window.
